_about: Tests known to fail now and then for timing reasons. The QA runner never retries them; a failure is still a failure, it is only labelled. Remove an entry once the test is made reliable.

tests.why: waits for the MOTD with a fixed timeout; fails when the PC is busy (e.g. a packaged-app check running at the same time); passes when run alone
QA self-test: its inner pytest run came back with an empty test id once inside a full 'all' run (PC busy with packaged checks); passed 5/5 alone right after. Cause not found yet.
